description:
EasyReader App removes barriers to accessible reading. With global links to libraries, it enables anyone with a print disability to read independently


NEW: Improved audiobook reader view
NEW: Simplified audiobook layout for easier navigation with assistive technology,
including AAC software, eye-tracking and switch controls,
NEW: Navigation Options for skipping forward and back are now located in the reader view.
NEW: Word spacing controls to improve readability
General bug fixes and accessibility improvements.
